title: Pancakes for Breakfast
text:
Maria wants to make pancakes. She needs eggs, milk, and flour. She puts the flour in a big bowl. Then she adds the eggs and milk.

Maria mixes everything with a spoon. Then she cooks the pancakes in a hot pan. They are soft and sweet. Her family eats them with honey.

questions.text: What does Maria need to make pancakes?
What does Maria use to mix everything?
How does Maria's family probably feel about the pancakes?
What can we say about Maria's breakfast at the end of the text?

combines different things together so they become one

paragraph_translations: María quiere hacer panqueques. Necesita huevos, leche y harina. Pone la harina en un tazón grande. Luego añade los huevos y la leche.
María mezcla todo con una cuchara. Después cocina los panqueques en una sartén caliente. Son suaves y dulces. Su familia los come con miel.
